_comment: Staged launch of the Portals gateway. `public: true` exposes a portal on the production website (header, footer, Connect sheet, homepage, hub, direct URLs, API). `public: false` removes every public reference and blocks its production URLs, while the code stays in the repo and the portal remains reachable in development and on Vercel preview deployments. Flip a flag, then run: node scripts/build-portals.js && node scripts/propagate-nav.js && node scripts/propagate-chrome.js && node scripts/propagate-launch.js && node scripts/check-nav.js && node scripts/check-launch.js

infoPages._comment: Public information pages that talk about a professional portal; gated with the same flag.
